title: The Gilded Root
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The gilded root is a golden tuber that grows only in the shadow of the old palace, and the city of Marrakech-of-the-West has fed on it for three hundred years. When the root begins to wither, gardener Thalia digs down to find its source — and discovers the palace was built on the back of a living thing.
